when_to_use: When a project is UI-heavy, as the Tier-1 conditional formatting kit; exactly one brand is chosen from it
When the project is UI-heavy and needs a minimal, technical, AI-native product interface (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/vercel/)
When the product is dense and keyboard-driven, such as an issue tracker or design tool (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/linear.app/)
When the product is content-first and document-centric (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/notion/)
When the surface is developer documentation or enterprise billing (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/stripe/)
When the product is a collaborative design or canvas tool (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/figma/)
When the product is realtime, dense and notification-heavy (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/slack/)
When the product is a developer platform console with a documentation site (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/supabase/)
When the product is a commerce admin or a storefront (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/shopify/)
When the product is a consumer marketplace or booking flow (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/airbnb/)
When the product is a launcher, command palette or productivity utility (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/raycast/)
When the product is a terminal-based developer agent, as this one is (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/opencode.ai/)
When the product is a conversational assistant with a chat-first surface (vendored at registry/formatting/brands/claude/)
